entries.title: Psalms 123:1
segments: A Song of degrees. To You I lift up my eyes, O Dweller in Heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 123:2
segments: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] to the hand of their masters; as the eyes of a maiden to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait on the LORD our God, until He shall have mercy on us.

entries.title: Psalms 123:3
segments: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us; for we are exceedingly filled with scorn.

entries.title: Psalms 123:4
segments: Our soul is exceedingly filled [with] the contempt of those who are at ease, with the scorn of the proud.
